heading: INT. COUNTY COURTHOUSE - STAIRWELL LANDING - DAY

units.text: INT. COUNTY COURTHOUSE - STAIRWELL LANDING - DAY
A marble stairwell that echoes.
Dusty light through tall windows.
ATTORNEY NAOMI PEMBERTON-CLARKE (40s, charcoal suit, folder) climbs two steps at a time.
Behind her trots her junior, DEVANTE OYELOWO (20s, rolled sleeves, briefcase).
Devante, we have eight minutes.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: Ms. Pemberton-Clarke, the witness isn't here yet.
units.name: DEVANTE

units.text: She'll be here.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: They reach the landing.
A heavyset man waits at the window: JUDGE REGINALD "REGGIE" ABERNATHY (60s, robe over arm), eating a sandwich.
Counsel.
units.name: REGGIE

units.text: Your Honor.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: You're in my stairwell.
units.name: REGGIE

units.text: We're passing through.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: Sorry, sir. We didn't know it was private.
units.name: DEVANTE

units.text: It isn't. I just like the quiet.
units.name: REGGIE

units.text: Naomi and Devante glance at each other.
Reggie wipes crumbs from his sleeve.
Tell me, Ms. Pemberton-Clarke. Is your client going to take the stand?
units.name: REGGIE

units.text: I can't discuss strategy with the bench, Judge.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: Of course not.
units.name: REGGIE

units.text: He tosses the sandwich wrapper at a bin, and misses.
They all three stare at it.
Devante dives for the wrapper, and Naomi dives for the same one.
They collide at the bin.
The folder spills.
Papers slide across the marble.
Well, now I know what's in the file.
units.name: REGGIE

units.text: Naomi and Devante freeze on their knees.
Reggie picks up one page, reads it, and folds it.
Eight minutes, counsel. I'd hurry.
units.name: REGGIE

units.text: He walks down the stairs, leaving the page tucked in his pocket.
